source.method: UnityPy reads of PiggyLevelConfig (path 1611) and PiggyTypeConfig in sharedassets1.assets; field names from public IL2CPP metadata v39. No original executable code or assets imported.

adaptations: Levels run from 0 to 10; XP requirements are added between levels. HP and movement stay as in Sylve V15.

The ten existing species form a chain: reaching level 1 unlocks the next regular species; Normalito level 2 unlocks Brotalito. These prerequisites are Sylve rules, not the original browser's fill thresholds or the full Steam game's shop unlock prices.
The source browser's unlock fill thresholds (120, 3000, 8500, 9561, 13500, 22500, 25485, 63000) concern a different roster. They are not used as kill requirements.

Weight = base weight × max(0.25, 1 - 0.075 × level) × (2 at level 0, otherwise 1). This level-dependent formula is a Sylve adaptation; the original executable's exact selection formula has not been verified.
Weights and pity of species absent from the browser build are explicit Sylve choices; Brotalito keeps its separate 70% roll after Normalito is destroyed.
A newly unlocked regular species is guaranteed at the next eligible spawn. Pity counters advance only on eligible normal draws; population limits and delayed bombs remain respected.

Progress survives rounds and deliveries in the same chantier. Closing a chantier resets it. Existing species unlocked by V15 order progression are retained without fabricating XP; saved V1–V15 simulations keep their prior rules.
